title: Indexes
description: Creating and managing all types of indexes for query performance optimization, including clustered, non-clustered, filtered, unique, and included columns.
longDescription: This module covers SQL Server indexes in depth. You'll learn about clustered and non-clustered indexes, how to create and manage them, filtered indexes, indexes with included columns, unique indexes, and how to disable, enable, rename, and drop indexes.
whatYouLearn: Understand the purpose and types of SQL Server indexes
Create clustered indexes to physically order data
Create non-clustered indexes to speed up queries
Use filtered indexes to index a subset of rows
Add included columns to non-clustered indexes
Disable and enable indexes for maintenance
